selection: Every record is decoded and gated by tools/car_roster.py. The first five are the T-007
reference anchors (one per drivetrain mix) and must not move. Cars 6-15 are the V1 audit's
high/medium-confidence class-B batch 1; cars 16-25 are batch 2: the seven high-confidence C
records (record-level AmaxVehicle.dynamics -> RP_CarDynamics id -> engine tag model, from
_work/vehicle-pipeline/c-aliases.json) plus three high-confidence B cars with exact .model
entries. Each has a complete car-parts manifest, a P52-style material pass, its own geometry
chunk and a measured 310 m scripted run. A C entry carries the exact model override plus the
AmaxVehicle identity it was resolved from; no name similarity or nearest file is used.

shortCourseController.reason: the 29 m regression's P37 throttle hold leaves this 1300 kg RWD record 0.4 m outside the 6 m finish gate (measured: finish z 1046.62 at x -57.89, gate z 1047..1053); the generic high-speed damper never engages because lateral speed stays below 2.5 m/s. The recovery profile is a deterministic proportional lane hold (gain 0.8 /m, 0.25 per m/s lateral, 0.2 m deadband) that keeps the car inside the gate
shortCourseController.scope: 29 m straight regression controller only; engine physics and the 310 m / lap / free controllers are unchanged
